subject: Proposal: interim bridge & tiered ramp for Oct renewal
messages:
From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@acornhealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-09-21T09:18:00-07:00
Subject: Renewal planning: Oct 31 window + interim options

Hi Lena —

Thanks again for taking time last week. With your Oct 31 renewal target in mind I wanted to share two pragmatic ways to handle the term transition while we finalize the expanded capacity request: a short "bridge" term to keep production uninterrupted, or a direct multi-tier renewal with a graded ramp.

Quick summary of what we saw from usage: Acorn has spiked to ~2.3M tokens/day in Aug/Sept with a handful of daily peaks. We can cover that in the Dedicated plan, but the ask you have for Q1 capacity means the budget profile needs smoothing.

Attached is a short workbook with both options and example invoices (Acorn_Renewal_Bridge_Proposal_2026.xlsx). Key points: 
- Bridge (3 months): keeps existing pricing for current capacity, adds a short fixed fee for reserved burst capacity, and pushes the larger capacity commit to Jan 1.
- Tiered multi-year: Year 1 smaller commit with automatic ramp steps into Year 2 to reach the capacity you requested; includes a 10% annual discount on the incremental commit tier.

If helpful, Ben can outline how we map burst capacity to autoscaling policies so you only pay for sustained increases. Can we do a 30-min call Tuesday to walk options and any procurement constraints?

Best,
Alex Martinez
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Acorn_Renewal_Bridge_Proposal_2026.xlsx
From: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@acornhealth.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Daniel Kim <daniel.kim@acornhealth.com>, Acorn Procurement <procurement@acornhealth.com>
Date: 2026-09-21T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal planning: Oct 31 window + interim options

Alex —

Thanks, appreciate the options. We cannot extend beyond Oct 31 on an open gap; legal needs an active contract. The bridge looks promising if it can be capped and invoiced monthly. Also: procurement will need an SOW that lists data residency and audit logs to meet our compliance gate.

I'll loop in procurement but please include a short SOW and a one-page compliance appendix.

—Lena
Director of Data Platforms
Acorn Health
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>

On Wed, Sep 21, 2026 at 10:03 AM Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@acornhealth.com> wrote:
> Alex —
> 
> Thanks, appreciate the options. We cannot extend beyond Oct 31 on an open gap; legal needs an active contract.
> 
> —Lena

Hi Lena —

We can do a 12-week bridge with monthly invoices that will transition seamlessly into the Tiered plan on Jan 1 (if you choose that path). The bridge includes:

- Fixed reserved burst allowance (up to 30% above current peak)
- Short SLO addendum with 99.5% availability for inference endpoints
- Option to credit bridge fees toward first quarter committed spend if you sign the multi-year by Dec 15

I've attached a draft SOW and a one-page compliance appendix (SOW_bridge_terms_acorn_2026.pdf). The SOW calls out data residency, audit log retention (90 days by default, longer on request), and KMS integration.

Would you like us to send a redline-ready contract and an invoice template so procurement can start internal approvals?

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Account Director, Redwood Inference

Ben / Alex —

Procurement reviewed the SOW. A couple of asks before we can circulate to legal:

1) Can you confirm invoicing cadence is monthly for the bridge and whether bridge fees are refundable or creditable to the follow-on commitment?
2) We need an explicit list of IP/data handling controls and the audit link you mentioned.
3) Please provide a sample invoice and the exact termination clause for the bridge (we prefer 30 days notice).

If you can get those to us by EOD Tue (28th) we can move quickly.

Thanks —
Acorn Procurement Team
From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>
To: Acorn Procurement <procurement@acornhealth.com>, Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@acornhealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-09-28T11:07:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal planning: Oct 31 window + interim options

Thanks for the clear asks — below are answers and I've attached the redline-ready SOW and a sample monthly invoice.

Responses:
- Invoicing cadence: monthly, invoiced on the first business day for prior month usage. Bridge fees are creditable toward the first quarter committed spend if the multi-year Tiered agreement is signed and executed by Dec 15 (credit applied to Q1 invoice). Not refundable.
- IP/data handling: we support per-tenant encryption with customer-managed KMS, audit logs exported to your SIEM, role-based access controls, and SOC2 Type II reports available on request. See compliance appendix in the attached SOW.
- Termination clause: bridge term is month-to-month after initial 90-day period with 30 days notice; Redwood may terminate for material breach with 7 days notice for security incidents.

Attachments: Acorn_Renewal_Bridge_Proposal_2026.xlsx, SOW_bridge_terms_acorn_2026.pdf

Alex Martinez
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference

Lena / Procurement — next steps: we can issue the bridge SOW and a first-month invoice once you confirm PO number. If you'd like, we can also schedule a 20-min tech walk with our platform engineer to confirm KMS and log forwarding.

Thanks,
